title: Gen AI Engineer
description: Job description: Role : Gen AI Engineer Job Description: Collect and prepare data for training and evaluating multimodal foundation models. Experience in Data management, including data pre-processing, augmentation, and generation of synthetic data. This involves cleaning, labeling, and augmenting data to train and improve AI models. Experience in developing and deploying AI models in production environments. title: Program Director
description: Job Summary Program Director role responsible for shaping and driving complex enterprise programs focused on secure adoption of Azure platforms ensuring strategic alignment with long term business goals and regulatory expectations while optimizing hybrid working models and enhancing resilience of digital services that support global transactions and modern payment ecosystems. Responsibilities Drive end to end ownership of large scale technology programs that focus on secure Azure adoption while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy and regulatory obligations across all business units and global locations. Oversee program planning and roadmap development by defining scope milestones dependencies and resource needs that enable secure and resilient Azure security initiatives across hybrid work environments. Guide cross functional teams to integrate Azure security controls into application architectures infrastructure operations and data flows so that business services remain protected and continuously available. Coordinate risk assessment activities to identify security gaps within Azure workloads and associated payment services then translate findings into prioritized remediation plans with measurable outcomes. Provide direction for establishing program wide security governance structures including policies standards and procedures that embed Azure security practices into everyday operations and decision making. Align program deliverables with organizational strategy by ensuring that Azure security investments support long term growth improved customer trust and efficient digital payment experiences. Manage stakeholder expectations by communicating program status risks and achievements through concise narratives and dashboards that highlight progress toward secure cloud and payment transformation goals. Support development of reusable patterns and reference architectures for Azure security so that project teams can implement consistent controls and reduce time to market for new solutions. Drive continuous improvement by analyzing operational metrics incident trends and audit results to refine Azure security capabilities and strengthen resilience of transaction and payment platforms. Collaborate with finance and portfolio management partners to optimize program budgets and investment decisions ensuring that Azure security and payment initiatives deliver tangible business value. Enable hybrid work effectiveness by promoting secure access models identity controls and collaboration tools that protect program information while supporting flexible working arrangements. Mentor senior program managers and technical leads by sharing best practices in strategic leadership Azure security risk management and stakeholder engagement to build strong succession pipelines. Advance responsible technology outcomes by ensuring that security design decisions within Azure platforms contribute to safer financial transactions and more trustworthy digital experiences for society. Qualifications Apply deep experience in Azure security including identity access management network protection data security and compliance configuration to design secure program architectures and guardrails. Demonstrate strong strategic leadership capabilities by setting program vision influencing senior stakeholders and guiding complex decision making that balances risk cost and long term business impact. Leverage exposure to forex payments or broader financial transaction domains to interpret regulatory expectations operational risks and customer experience needs within secure digital payment programs. Use extensive experience in large enterprise environments to coordinate multidisciplinary teams vendors and partners while maintaining clarity of goals timelines and quality expectations. Employ advanced communication and negotiation skills to manage diverse stakeholders by turning technical security topics into understandable implications for business performance and customer trust. Draw on more than twenty two years of progressive program management experience to handle ambiguity orchestrate transformation agendas and deliver consistent outcomes over multi year horizons. Implement industry recognized frameworks for program management and security governance ensuring that practices are repeatable auditable and aligned with organizational policies and external regulations. Certifications Required Preferred certifications include Azure Security Engineer Associate and Certified Information Systems Security Professional CISSP or equivalent cloud security credentials.

description: The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices. The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry, including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll, and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies. We look to recruit bright, articulate and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. We value people who work hard, care about what they do and are prepared to innovate. Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive. About the Role We are looking for an offensive security engineer to deliver authorised internal penetration tests of applications and APIs and to support broader red-team exercises. You will combine structured methodology with manual curiosity to find weaknesses that scanners and standard control checks miss. The role requires disciplined evidence, safe testing and clear reporting. You will work within approved rules of engagement and escalate immediately if test activity could affect service, data or users. Location: Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role. Key Duties and Responsibilities Execute internal web application and API penetration tests using approved methodologies, test plans and rules of engagement. Test authentication, session management, authorisation, input handling, data exposure, file processing, API object access and workflow controls. Develop misuse and abuse cases from business processes, user roles and trust assumptions; explore ways legitimate functionality could be manipulated. Use interception proxies, API clients, fuzzers, scanners and scripts to support—not replace—manual analysis. Inspect client-side code, API documentation, requests, responses and relevant source or configuration where access is approved. Document reproducible steps, requests and responses, affected roles, preconditions, impact and safe proof of exploitability. Remove false positives and duplicates, apply the severity methodology and seek peer review for high-risk or ambiguous findings. Prepare clear technical reports and concise summaries; explain findings to development teams without relying on jargon. Retest remediated findings and record whether the original attack path and relevant variants are closed. Support senior testers during objective-led red-team or purple-team exercises, including evidence capture and controlled validation. Create small scripts, test data and harnesses to improve repeatability; keep tooling approved, updated and securely stored. Share recurring vulnerabilities and root causes with AppSec engineers so guidance, threat models and pipeline controls can improve. Maintain accurate engagement status, evidence location, finding records and handover notes. Knowledge, Skills and Experience Typically 2-5 years in penetration testing, application security or security testing, with demonstrable hands-on web or API testing. Good understanding of HTTP, web architecture, REST APIs, cookies/tokens, authentication, authorisation and common vulnerability classes. Practical experience with an interception proxy and API-testing tools, plus basic scripting in Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar. Ability to distinguish a theoretical weakness from a reproducible, impactful security finding. Clear report writing with accurate evidence, remediation guidance and professional communication. Understanding of testing safety, confidentiality, approvals and responsible handling of credentials and sensitive data. Ability to receive peer review positively and improve testing based on feedback. Fluent English, spoken and written. Additional Practical Experience Evidence of practical offensive security development through hands-on labs, testing projects or structured training. Experience testing GraphQL, gRPC, mobile back ends, single-page applications or modern identity protocols. Exposure to Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, containers or CI/CD security. Secure code review or software development experience. Experience in financial services or another regulated environment. Candidate Expectations Stay within scope and use safe proofs; immediately report unexpected access or service impact. Test the business process, not only the endpoint or vulnerability checklist. Write with precision and avoid inflated severity or unsupported claims. Collaborate respectfully with the teams whose systems are being tested. Develop your tradecraft through deliberate practice and active participation from the Hyderabad office.
